hits.doc: The function `sin x / x` modified to take the value 1 at 0, which makes it continuous.
hits.name: Real.sinc

hits.doc: The function `sinc` is positive on `(-π, π)`.
hits.name: Real.sinc_pos
Real.sinc_of_ne_zero
hits.type: {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) : Real.sinc x = Real.sin x / x

hits.name: Real.sinc_apply
hits.type: {x : ℝ} : Real.sinc x = if x = 0 then 1 else Real.sin x / x

hits.doc:
For `|x| < π / 2` we have `cos x ≤ sinc x`, and together with
`sinc_le_one` this gives the squeeze `cos x ≤ sin x / x ≤ 1`.
hits.name: Real.cos_le_sinc
hits.type: {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < Real.pi / 2) : Real.cos x ≤ Real.sinc x

hits.name: integral_exp_mul_I_eq_sinc
hits.type: (r : ℝ) : ∫ (t : ℝ) in -r..r, Complex.exp (↑t * Complex.I) = 2 * ↑r * ↑(Real.sinc r)
